DEWARIM_ITEMS.Title: Item templates
DEWARIM_ITEMS.Hint: Make items from a base: variants by strength or quality, quick mundane items from rows, rider effects.
DEWARIM_ITEMS.Intro: Make items from a base item: pick a preset on the left and press New, then drop the base item into the template.
DEWARIM_ITEMS.BaseDrop: Drop an item here (sidebar or compendium)
DEWARIM_ITEMS.BaseMissing: The base item is gone - drop a new one.
DEWARIM_ITEMS.PatternHint: {base} the base's name, {tier} the tier, {percent} the strength (+14%), {name} a row's name, {~word} a word that follows the item's language (dnd5e: {~wild} → Wild / Wilder). Empty: the mode's default.
DEWARIM_ITEMS.RangeHint: Change against the base: +50 % … +100 % heals 1.5 to 2 times as much. Each item rolls its own; the same seed rolls the same.
DEWARIM_ITEMS.RerollHint: A new seed: other strengths on the next Generate
DEWARIM_ITEMS.TiersHint: One item per tier; the strength is its change against the base (−50 % halves, +100 % doubles) - the aspects that follow the strength use it.

Rows.ColumnHint: A column is a data path such as system.material.
Rows.Hint: One item per row, like the base but with the row's name, price, weight, image and note; extra columns set data paths. Empty cells keep the base's value.
Rows.PasteHint: Copy cells from a spreadsheet with a header row: name, price, weight, img, note, or data paths (system.material). A row with a known name replaces it.
Rows.Name: Name

DEWARIM_ITEMS.NoAspects: No aspects: the items are the base with new names (and the rows' values).
DEWARIM_ITEMS.AspectsHint: Follows strength: the aspect takes the variant's strength on top of its own change. Price +10 % without it: always 10 % more.

Aspect.RiderDrop: Drop an item with a save (Potion of Poison) to take its save and effect.

DEWARIM_ITEMS.UpdateHint: Replaces the item made earlier (same id)
DEWARIM_ITEMS.NothingToMake: Nothing to make: add tiers or rows.
DEWARIM_ITEMS.StaleHint: Made earlier, no longer by this template:
DEWARIM_ITEMS.RemoveConfirm: Remove the template {name}? The items it made stay.
DEWARIM_ITEMS.StaleConfirm: These items were made by this template earlier and are not part of it any more. Delete them?
DEWARIM_ITEMS.DropNotOwned: Drop an item from the sidebar or a compendium, not one of an actor.
DEWARIM_ITEMS.NoRider: {name} has no save with an effect.

Settings.AutomateRidersHint: When an item with a rider is used, the drinker rolls the save and gets the effect on a failure. Off: the chat card offers the effect to apply by hand.
Settings.ThresholdsHint: Highest price (gp) of a common, uncommon, rare and very rare item, for aspects that set the rarity by price; above: legendary.

Generic.Hint: Where this system keeps it on an item (system.price). Empty: not changed.

Dnd5e.RiderText: Hard to keep down: DC {dc} {ability} saving throw or {condition} for {duration}.
